title: [Task Sprint] QA Testing Report — GoThru API New

issues.main_description_html:
QA Bug Report — Storage full state is never exposed

Test date: 2026-08-26
Environment: Production API (https://apil.gothru.co) and current dashboard source
Test account: Tester-owned account (credentials and tokens redacted)
Scope: Storage-detail contract and the dashboard consumer. No upload, storage mutation, or cleanup action was performed.

Verdict

Bug confirmed — coding defect. The API clamps the calculated remaining storage to zero before computing is_full; therefore is_full can never be true even after actual usage exceeds the quota.

Reproduction

  1. Call the authenticated storage endpoint for an account whose calculated usage is above its plan quota.
  2. Inspect data.is_full in the response.
  3. Expected: is_full: true when raw remaining storage is below zero.
  4. Actual: is_full: false, because the raw negative value is discarded before the comparison.

API evidence

Case Method and endpoint Sanitized request Expected Actual Result
Authentication POST /auth/login { "email": "<tester-email>", "password": "<redacted>" } Authenticated session 200, token issued Pass
Storage baseline GET /v1/users/detail-storage?ec=false Authorization: <redacted> Readable storage contract 200; plan 2 GB, used 1.8 GB, free 0.2 GB, is_full: false Pass (near-full baseline)
Encrypted contract GET /v1/users/detail-storage?ec=true Authorization: <redacted> Encrypted envelope 200; encrypted fields returned Pass
Missing-auth guard GET /v1/users/detail-storage?ec=false No Authorization header Authentication rejected 401, Token required Pass
Full-state contract GET /v1/users/detail-storage?ec=false Authorization: <redacted>; account usage greater than quota is_full: true Source path makes is_full: false for every input Fail

Copyable request and response shape

GET https://apil.gothru.co/v1/users/detail-storage?ec=false
Authorization: <tester-token>
{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "messages": "Data retrieved",
    "storage_used": 1.8,
    "storage_free": 0.2,
    "storage_plan": 2,
    "storage_google": 1.377634048461914,
    "storage_overlay": 0.4253883361816406,
    "is_full": false
  }
}

The live tester account was intentionally not filled past its quota: creating a full-state fixture would require a persistent panorama/file upload and worker processing. The defective branch is deterministic from the deployed source contract.

Code review

Component Finding Evidence Impact
DetailStorageV1 $free is clamped with max(0, $plan - $spaceGb) app/Http/Controllers/User/Storage/V1/Action/DetailStorageV1.php Negative raw remaining-space value is lost.
DetailStorageV1 is_full is evaluated as $free < 0 after the clamp Same file Predicate is unreachable; full state cannot be represented.
Dashboard mapper Preserves backend is_full as isFull gothru-dashboard/src/utils/checkStorage.js Any consumer of the flag receives the incorrect false value.
Dashboard guards UI additionally derives full state from storageUsed.percent >= 100 gothru-dashboard/src/hooks/useStorage.jsx, components/organism/SideMenu/Side.jsx UI can warn by percentage, but this does not repair the incorrect API contract.

Test-method coverage

Method Scenario Result
Black box Real login, authenticated storage detail, encrypted response, and missing-auth guard Pass except full-state fixture not safely created.
Gray box Matched the live request/response contract to dashboard storage mapping and warning thresholds Confirms FE receives the backend flag unchanged.
White box Traced quota calculation and is_full predicate Fail: impossible condition after clamping.

Confusion matrix for is_full

Actual storage state Expected API is_full Current implementation Classification
Usage within plan false false True negative
Usage above plan true false False negative — defect

Recommended fix

Compute the flag from the unclamped value, then clamp only the public storage_free field. For example:

$rawFree = $plan - $spaceGb;
$free = max(0, $rawFree);
$isFull = $rawFree < 0;

Return "is_full" => $isFull.

Scope and safety notes

  • No response code 500 was produced by the storage-detail endpoint in this run.
  • No persistent upload, quota change, archive, deletion, or shared-state operation was performed.
  • Tokens, passwords, session data, and non-public identifiers are omitted.
